requirements.text: * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications.
* Solid proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations.

* Experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with CI/CD pipelines and observability tooling, with interest in infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform) and feature flag systems.
* Comfortable working in agent\-first development workflows \- defining clear acceptance criteria and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar.
* A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, participating in code reviews, and producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents.
* Track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact, with growing autonomy.
* Startup or fast\-paced team experience is a plus.
* Authorized to work in the US for any employer.
* Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus.
